neighbours.label: the lone token ' R' opening a rarer proper name that is spelled out in pieces (Rikers, Rurik, Rzeszow, Rilke); single-token R-names (Richmond, Russia, Robert) stay quiet. The + pole also peaks on ' R' / ' N' name starts
